# qualys_ip_registration (Resource)

Registers IP addresses with a Qualys subscription and enables them for scanning.

~> **Destroying this resource does not remove the addresses from Qualys.** The
Qualys API provides no action to delete IPs from a subscription. Set
`purge_on_destroy` to purge their vulnerability data instead, or remove the
addresses from the Qualys UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qualys_ip_registration" "web_tier" {
  ips        = ["10.20.0.0/24"]
  network_id = qualys_network.dmz.id

  enable_vm = true

  tracking_method = "DNS"
  owner           = "platform-team"
}
```

## Purging

`purge_on_destroy` is destructive and irreversible. It deletes vulnerability and
compliance data, tickets and exceptions, and removes the assets from AssetView.
Scan results themselves are retained.

Purging is also asynchronous: Qualys queues the hosts and processes them in the
background, so the data may still be visible for a short time after apply
returns. It does **not** un-register the addresses — the API cannot do that.

## Tracking methods

`EC2` and `AGENT` cannot be set through this API, and a host already tracked by
either cannot be changed away from it. Only `IP`, `DNS` and `NETBIOS` are
settable.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- **ips** (Set of String) Addresses to register. Accepts single addresses, hyphenated ranges and CIDR blocks. Changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- **asset_group_title** (String) Add the addresses to this existing asset group as they are registered. Applied at creation only.
- **comment** (String)
- **enable_pc** (Boolean) Enable these addresses for Policy Compliance scanning. Defaults to `false`.
- **enable_vm** (Boolean) Enable these addresses for Vulnerability Management scanning. Defaults to `true`.
- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **network_id** (String) Qualys network these addresses belong to. Changing this forces replacement.
- **owner** (String)
- **purge_on_destroy** (Boolean) When destroying, purge the hosts' vulnerability data. Defaults to `false`.
- **tracking_method** (String) How Qualys identifies these hosts. One of `IP`, `DNS`, `NETBIOS`.
- **ud1** (String)
- **ud2** (String)
- **ud3** (String)
